rule: Before trusting a completed fleet-dispatch PR, diff it against the CURRENT authoritative spec/founder ruling (not just CI-green/clean-diff), since the brief was frozen at enqueue and may have been superseded.

Treat durable state files (STATUS.md, ledgers, boards) as hypotheses dated to the last desk session, not live fact, and ask the founder directly rather than inferring effort/progress from files or git activity.

Any text-parsing verdict/gate must collect every match (not first-match), normalize CRLF before pattern matching, and tolerate/contractually forbid markdown emphasis around structured verdict lines, with explicit fail-open/fail-closed choice per pattern.

Never infer a fix/gate/check's success from a green or quiet signal alone; verify the actual artifact/behavior (committed binary vs source, a gate that actually ran, a live re-measurement on the correct ref) rather than a proxy report of success.
Every deterministic style/denylist/threshold gate must be run against its authentic ground-truth corpus before being registered, and must pass ~all authentic samples (anti-recall gates exempted).
check: CI job that runs each registered validator against its stored ground-truth corpus fixture and asserts pass-rate above a documented threshold
misses: a brand-new validator that is never wired into the corpus-test harness in the first place (nothing forces its creation), and thresholds picked from an unrepresentative or stale corpus sample

rule: Adversarial review must give reviewers genuinely different lenses (and different model families) rather than the same framing, because same-lens/same-model reviewers ratify shared errors instead of catching them.

Every gate/audit/certification claim recorded in a plan or report must link its concrete artifact (PR comment URL, run ID, CI link); an unlinked claim is treated as unverified regardless of who asserts it.
check: lint/text-gate that scans plan and report documents for certification/verification keywords (e.g. "certified", "verified", "audit passed", "gate: PASS") and fails if no adjacent URL/run-ID pattern is present
misses: paraphrased claims that avoid the exact keyword list, and claims with a present-but-wrong or fabricated-looking link that points to unrelated content

rule: Before basing a conclusion on a documented config value (temperature, seed, flags), trace it to the actual outgoing request/code path rather than trusting the prereg/memo/README.

Never conclude a credential's health from its stored value, version, or a consumer's error text alone; exercise it against the real endpoint (discriminating 401 vs 403), check its prefix against the claimed type, and prove the path on a cache-cold target.

When the founder must make a genuinely visual choice among images/options, build a self-contained HTML picker Artifact with embedded thumbnails and a copy-selection button rather than describing options in prose.

When reality can diverge from a stated policy (rogue re-adds, config drift, verbal routing rules), the fix must be a runtime/admission/OS-level enforcement mechanism, never another policy document, and failures must hard-fail loud rather than degrade silently.

Act autonomously unless an action is BOTH irreversible AND its blast radius reaches fleet/infra/external (or it edits the act-vs-ask machinery itself), in which case ask or hard-gate; otherwise act and report.
